title: Nothing to do here
prompt: It is 10:15 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: Not every chart has a trade in it. Look at what price is doing and what it has taken. Then decide whether there is anything to act on at all.

whyNot.label: trading the range edges
whyNot.why: A tight range with no liquidity taken and no displacement has no edge at the edges. Every move out of it is as likely to fail as to run.

whyNot.label: forcing a bias from the last candles
whyNot.why: Three candles up is not structure. The Daily and 4H have no direction here, so there's nothing for a lower-timeframe entry to align with.

reference.summary: A tight, overlapping range with equal highs and lows inside it. No external liquidity was taken, nothing displaced and the higher timeframe is flat. Standing aside is the position.

bias.why: The Daily and 4H are ranging: overlapping candles, no higher highs or lower lows to speak of.

decision.why: No sweep, no displacement, no bias. There is nothing to wait for either: this is a day to not trade until the chart changes.

draw.why: There's no clear pool price is being drawn to.

location.why: Price is in the middle of its range.

next_objective.why: Price reached none of the pools in view (the previous day's range, the nearest swings, the nearest gap) and stayed inside a narrow range. With no pool drawing it, "no clear objective" was the read that held up.

annotations.label: Morning range high 20,623.25
annotations.why: Equal highs inside a range look like liquidity. With no move towards them and nothing displacing, they are noise.
annotations.whyNot: Internal liquidity in a chop isn't a draw. Wait until price actually leaves the range.

annotations.label: Asia high 20,624.5
annotations.why: Real, inside the same range, and untouched.

annotations.label: Small 5m gap
annotations.why: A gap too small to carry a trade in a market that isn't moving.

annotations.label: Previous day high 20,609.75
annotations.why: Far above, and price shows no interest in it.

confluences.label: Overlapping, directionless candles
confluences.why: That is the whole picture: there's no edge in the middle of a range.

confluences.label: Higher timeframe has no direction
confluences.why: Nothing for a lower-timeframe entry to align with.

confluences.label: Equal highs inside the range
confluences.why: Internal liquidity in a chop isn't a reason to trade.

confluences.label: Inside the NY AM window
confluences.why: Being in the right window isn't a setup.

lookFor: Ask first whether there's anything to trade. Taking nothing is a result.
Equal highs inside a range aren't a target until price leaves it.
Wait for a sweep of something external and displacement, not for boredom to end.
